name: source1-lighting
description: Source-1 lighting entity set for Geppetto Desktop (hammer-lighting-environment-sun-fog): the six lighting classes core-source1.json does not ship — light_environment, env_sun, light_dynamic, env_fog_controller, shadow_control, env_tonemap_controller. light and light_spot already ship in source1-core. Every class implicitly accepts the base keyvalues classname (string), targetname (string), parentname (target), angles (angle) and spawnflags (int); they are not repeated per class.

classes.name: light_environment
classes.description: Sun light: direct sunlight (_light) plus ambient (_ambient). Position does not matter; angles point at the sun (pitch positive-down, elevation is -pitch). Pair with an env_sun for the visible sun sprite. Only the first one in a map is used.

keyvalues.name: _light
keyvalues.description: Sun direct colour (R G B, 0-255) and brightness (4th component, default 200).

keyvalues.name: _ambient
keyvalues.description: Ambient colour (R G B, 0-255) and brightness (4th component). Black = no ambient term.

keyvalues.name: pitch
keyvalues.description: Sun pitch in degrees (negative = sun above the horizon, shining down). Non-zero overrides the pitch in angles.

classes.name: env_sun
classes.description: Visible sun sprite in the sky. Angles point at the sun (same convention as light_environment); pair with a light_environment for the actual sun light.

keyvalues.name: overlaycolor
keyvalues.description: Sun glow overlay colour (R G B, 0-255).

classes.name: light_dynamic
classes.description: Realtime (dynamic) point light. Never baked: it reaches the live preview only, and is excluded from the native bake light list.

keyvalues.name: _light
keyvalues.description: Light colour (R G B, 0-255) and brightness (4th component, default 200).

keyvalues.name: _distance
keyvalues.description: Maximum distance the light reaches. 0 = infinite.

keyvalues.name: style
keyvalues.description: Light style (0 = normal, 1-63 = flicker patterns). Non-zero styles are not baked.

classes.name: env_fog_controller
classes.description: Distance fog controller: linear fog between fogstart and fogend, capped at fogmaxdensity. First controller in a map wins.

keyvalues.name: fogcolor2
keyvalues.description: Secondary fog colour (R G B, 0-255). No Geppetto consumer reads it yet.

keyvalues.name: fogstart
keyvalues.description: Near distance where fog starts. 0 = unset.

keyvalues.name: fogend
keyvalues.description: Far distance where fog is opaque. 0 = unset.

keyvalues.name: farz
keyvalues.description: Far Z clip distance. -1 = unset. No Geppetto consumer reads it yet.

classes.name: shadow_control
classes.description: Shadow controller: shadow colour and maximum shadow distance. First controller in a map wins.

keyvalues.name: disableallshadows
keyvalues.description: Disable all shadows (1) or not (0). Needs a bake flag the runner does not take yet.

classes.name: env_tonemap_controller
classes.description: HDR tonemap / auto-exposure controller. Render-time only: it never feeds the lightmap bake. First controller in a map wins.

keyvalues.name: tonemap_percent_bright_pixels
keyvalues.description: Percent of bright pixels driving exposure, 0..100.
